set -Eeuo pipefail
sudo -n -H /usr/bin/python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import os,re,stat,sys,tempfile,subprocess
base=Path('/opt/telegram-robot-leads');vault=Path('/root/project-secrets/telegram-robot-leads')
env=vault/'.env'
backup=vault/'.env.backup.rea-final-hygiene-20261030'
assert not backup.exists(),'backup path already exists'
assert env.is_file() and not env.is_symlink() and stat.S_IMODE(env.stat().st_mode)==0o600
assert env.stat().st_uid==os.geteuid()
assert stat.S_IMODE(vault.stat().st_mode)&0o077==0
sys.path.insert(0,str(base/'scripts'))
from telethon_sessions import inspect
original=env.read_bytes()
config_before=inspect(vault)
unused={'TELEGRAM_REGION_SPLIT','TELEGRAM_ACCOUNT_REGIONS','WORKER_LOGIN_STAGGER_SEC','TELEGRAM_BALANCE_DAILY_TARGETS','TELEGRAM_QUEUE_PARTITION','TELEGRAM_UNIFIED_HUMAN_SCHEDULE','HUMAN_PAUSE_MIN_SEC','HUMAN_PAUSE_MAX_SEC','HUMAN_PAUSE_MODE_SEC','TELEGRAM_PEERFLOOD_WAIT_MIN_SEC','TELEGRAM_PEERFLOOD_WAIT_MAX_SEC','TELEGRAM_INVITE_COOLDOWN_UNTIL','TELEGRAM_SCRAPE_RELAX_NAME_FILTER','TELEGRAM_INVITE_NEWEST_FIRST','TELEGRAM_SEARCH_LIMIT','TELEGRAM_SCRAPE_MAX_PER_GROUP','QUEUE_EMPTY_WAIT_SEC','TELEGRAM_PRIORITY_SCRAPE_GROUPS','TELEGRAM_FIXED_SCRAPE_GROUPS'}
scripts=[p for p in (base/'scripts').iterdir() if p.is_file() and p.suffix in ('.py','.sh')]
for name in unused:
 assert all(name not in p.read_text(errors='replace') for p in scripts),'key remains used in code '+name
pattern=re.compile(r'^\s*(?:export\s+)?([A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*)\s*=')
lines=original.decode('utf-8').splitlines(keepends=True)
kept=[];removed=[]
for line in lines:
 m=pattern.match(line)
 if m and m.group(1) in unused:removed.append(m.group(1))
 else:kept.append(line)
assert set(removed)==unused,'unexpected legacy configuration inventory'
assert len(removed)==len(unused)
cleaned=''.join(kept).encode('utf-8')
def atomic(dst,data):
 fd,tmp=tempfile.mkstemp(prefix='.rea-config-',dir=str(vault))
 try:
  with os.fdopen(fd,'wb') as handle:
   handle.write(data);handle.flush();os.fsync(handle.fileno())
  os.chmod(tmp,0o600)
  os.replace(tmp,dst)
 finally:
  if os.path.lexists(tmp):os.unlink(tmp)
fd=os.open(backup,os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL|os.O_NOFOLLOW,0o600)
with os.fdopen(fd,'wb') as handle:
 handle.write(original);handle.flush();os.fsync(handle.fileno())
try:
 atomic(env,cleaned)
 config_after=inspect(vault)
 assert config_before==config_after,'Telegram account config changed'
 p=subprocess.run([str(base/'.venv/bin/python'),'-m','unittest','discover','-s','tests','-p','test_*.py','-q'],cwd=str(base),capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=100,env={**os.environ,'PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE':'1'})
 print('TEST_EXIT',p.returncode)
 print('TEST_RESULT',(p.stdout+p.stderr)[-1500:])
 assert p.returncode==0 and 'Ran 221 tests' in p.stdout+p.stderr and 'OK' in p.stdout+p.stderr,'test suite did not pass'
 print('CONFIG_CLEAN_PASS','removed_keys',len(removed),'all_preserved_accounts',len(config_after['entries']))
 print('LEGACY_KEYS_REMOVED',','.join(sorted(removed)))
 print('BACKUP_CREATED',backup.name,'mode',oct(stat.S_IMODE(backup.stat().st_mode)))
except Exception as error:
 atomic(env,original)
 assert inspect(vault)==config_before,'rollback config check failed'
 print('CONFIG_ROLLBACK_COMPLETE',type(error).__name__,str(error)[:120])
 raise
print('CONFIG_TRANSACTION_DONE')
PY
